name: WLF_PRICING_RULES_F
description: Table to store Pricing Rules information.

columns.name: PRICING_RULE_ID
columns.description: System generated unique identifier.

columns.name: PRICING_RULE_NUMBER
columns.description: PRICING_RULE_NUMBER

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_START_DATE
columns.description: Date Effective Entity: indicates the date at the beginning of the date range within which the row is effective.

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
columns.description: Date Effective Entity: indicates the date at the end of the date range within which the row is effective.

columns.name: TOTAL_PRICE
columns.description: Indicates the total cost of the pricing rule.

columns.name: CURRENCY
columns.description: Indicates the currency type of the price.

columns.name: LEARNING_ITEM_TYPE
columns.description: Indicates the type of learning item for which pricing is set.

columns.name: DELIVERY_MODE
columns.description: Indicates the delivery mode of learning item for which pricing is set.

columns.name: USAGE
columns.description: Polymorphic discriminator column {ORA_SETTINGS,ORA_COURSE... }.

columns.name: USES_PRICING
columns.description: Indicates whether pricing is used or not.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: ENTERPRISE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of Enterprise, used for multi-tenancy partitioning. Foreign key to HR_ORGANIZATION_UNITS.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: PAYMENT_TYPE
columns.description: Indicates the payment typeof learning item.

columns.name: REFUND_TYPE
columns.description: Indicates refund type for the payment.

columns.name: REFUND_ON_WITHDRAWAL_ENABLED
columns.description: Indicates if refund on withdrawal is enabled.

columns.name: IS_PO_REQUIRED
columns.description: Indicates if purchase order is required.

columns.name: RFND_ON_WITHDRAW_ENA_SP
columns.description: Indicates if refund on withdrawal is enabled for self paced offering.
